_about: Building a patch, one way for the Python Patch Builder and the viewer's: run by tests/test_build_cases.py (service.build_record_patch, a dry run) and viewer-shell/editcore/tests/cases.rs (editcore::build). Each case is the source plugins' records (`sources`, header included, in file order), the load `order`, the masters' `sizes`, the patch's file name (`output`) and its `plan`: selections [plugin, type, key], merges {type, key, base, choices [{path, plugin} | {path, value}]}, carried (an earlier build's records), ref_edits {cell, origin, refr_index, changes, plugins}, new_refs {cell, uid, fields, base_plugin, plugins} and new_records {type, key, record, source, topic}. `expect` is the document the build would write (header first) with what it reports, or {error}. Generated from the Python side when a case is added, and read by hand.
